shorts.title: This WorldEdit edit hasn't happened yet
shorts.alternate_title: Don't press Enter in WorldEdit. Look first.
shorts.description:
That replacement is still a visual draft. WorldEdit Selection Overlay shows the supported command result while you type; Escape restores the original view. The preview does not edit the world.

Live command preview requires compatible local WorldEdit in singleplayer. Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 / 26.2; choose the Fabric or NeoForge download. NeoForge local WorldEdit on 26.1.x requires 26.1.2.

shorts.title: I hid the walls. The Minecraft house is still there.
shorts.alternate_title: See inside your Minecraft build without breaking it
shorts.description:
Pick the materials you want to inspect. Other blocks disappear visually only inside your WorldEdit selection, so you can look inside the build. Reset the checkboxes to see everything again. Real blocks and collisions stay unchanged.

This is a building inspection tool, not an ore finder. WorldEdit Selection Overlay 1.8.0 for Fabric and NeoForge.

shorts.title: Stop reselecting your WorldEdit build. Move the box.
shorts.alternate_title: Move your WorldEdit selection without touching the build

phases.edit-11: Y + Scroll  /  Move up or down

shorts.description:
Move the WorldEdit cuboid selection instead of placing its corners again. Hold G to choose Move, tap G to enter editing, then hold the left mouse button on the box. Choose X, Y or Z and scroll. Tap G to apply; Escape cancels the draft. The 3D axis indicator turns with the camera.

Only the selection bounds move, not the building. Enable in-world editing in the mod settings. Requires compatible local WorldEdit in singleplayer. Controls shown are the defaults.

shorts.pinned_comment: The box moves; the house doesn't. X / Y / Z selects the axis, G applies, and Esc cancels. Full walkthrough in the related video.

shorts.title: Your WorldEdit copy is facing the wrong way? Check this.
shorts.alternate_title: See your WorldEdit copy rotate before you commit
shorts.description:
Enable clipboard preview, copy your build, and check its placement view. While typing //rotate or //flip, WorldEdit Selection Overlay previews the new orientation without changing the real clipboard. Escape restores the preview.

Clipboard preview is off by default. Requires compatible local WorldEdit in singleplayer. WorldEdit Selection Overlay 1.8.0 for Fabric and NeoForge.
